tasks.title: Evaluate phase-one quality benchmark
tasks.objective: Make DT-18 quality decisions honest for the approved five-purpose benchmark.
steps: Keep evaluatePhase1QualityBenchmark(request) on createProductionGraphRagRuntime's returned public boundary.
Consume the Harness-provided benchmark purposes without inventing a precision release threshold, result cap, observation fallback, or default unrelated-hit evidence.
Reject empty mandatoryKeySeedIds and empty expectedClosureIds for every benchmark purpose.
Reject missing actual recalledKeySeedIds and missing actual observedClosureIds instead of falling back to mandatoryKeySeedIds or expectedClosureIds.
Reject missing or negative unrelatedForcedHits evidence; explicit 0 remains valid as recorded zero forced hits.
Reject empty benchmarks, incomplete five-purpose benchmark content, and per-purpose precision outside [0,1].
Compute key seed recall from actual mandatory-seed hits/intersection, not arbitrary recalled-id count.
Block non-empty missingKeySeedIds even when recalled-id count matches mandatory seed count.
Block closure correctness below 1 and unrelatedForcedHits greater than 0.
Return qualityEvidence.benchmarkId, purposes, perPurpose observations, keySeedRecall 1, closureCorrectness 1, unrelatedForcedHits 0, aggregatePrecision, and undefined releasePrecisionThreshold.
tasks.completionSignal: runRetrievalQualityBenchmark.js exits 0 and DT-18 records non-empty mandatory fixtures, 100% recall by mandatory-seed intersection, non-empty expected closure fixtures, 100% closure correctness, explicitly recorded zero forced unrelated hits, in-range precision evidence, and blocking failures for wrong same-count recall ids, missing key seeds, closure misses, positive unrelated hits, missing fixtures, fabricated/missing observations, missing/negative unrelated-hit evidence, empty/incomplete benchmarks, and out-of-range precision.
